items.item_text: Bachelors degree in higher education administration, healthcare administration, business administration, or a related field
Masters degree in higher education administration, public administration, healthcare administration, or a related field.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience in academic administration, student services, registrar operations, or program coordination.
Experience working in a medical school or health professions education program.
Experience supporting clinical education scheduling or rotation coordination.
Experience administering visiting student programs, VSLO processes, away rotations or clinical affiliation agreements.
Clinical Rotation Scheduling Administration:

Coordinates the annual Phase 3 scheduling cycle, including development and publication of the Phase 3 course catalog for clinical science selectives and electives, Health Systems Science (HSS) selectives, and other required Phase 3 courses.
Builds and maintains Phase 3 courses within the student information system and ensures accurate course configuration and registration functionality.
Develops, tests, maintains, and supports scheduling tools and processes used by third- and fourth-year students to create and manage clinical schedules.
Integrates departmental course offerings into the master clinical schedule to support curriculum delivery and student progression.
Coordinates annual registration processes for all Phase 3 students and maintains scheduling documentation and operational resources.
Student Schedule Management/Graduation Progression:
Educates third- and fourth-year students regarding curriculum requirements, scheduling processes, degree requirements, and registration procedures.
Reviews student scheduling submissions and rotation preferences to facilitate equitable assignment of students to clinical rotations within established capacity limits and degree requirements.
Schedules students into available clinical science selectives and electives, HSS selectives, and other required Phase 3 courses.
Processes schedule change requests, rotation trades, and scheduling adjustments while ensuring compliance with degree requirements andschool policies.
Applies academic and registrar policies when evaluating schedule changes and communicates approvals, denials, and schedule updates to students and stakeholders.
Monitors student progress toward degree completion and maintains accurate scheduling and enrollment records within institutional systems.
Extramural and Away Rotation Administration (VSLO):
Administers institutional participation in the Visiting Student Learning Opportunities (VSLO) platform and oversees processes related to visiting andextramural rotations.
Completes annual VSLO system setup, student verification, institutional configuration and documentation activities.
Uploads transcripts, institutional approvals, malpractice documentation, and other supporting materials required for student applications.

Reviews and pre-screens extramural elective applications; uploads transcripts, institutional approvals, malpractice documentation, and other materials required, and releases student applications to host institutions .
Monitor application status, enrollment activity, approvals, deadlines, and placement outcomes; communicates next steps to students and internal stakeholders
Enrolls students in approved away rotations and extramural electives and updates student schedules and institutional systems, and adjusts schedules when external rotation dates do not align.
Tracks and reports away rotation participation and enrollment data.
Clinical Affiliation Agreement Administration:

Coordinates the development, review, execution, and maintenance of clinical affiliation agreements required for student participation in away rotations and extramural clinical experiences, with oversight from the Director of Clinical Affairs.
Collaborates with legal, compliance, contracting, and external clinical site representatives to facilitate timely review and execution of affiliation agreements.
Maintains records of active affiliation agreements and monitors agreement status and expiration dates to ensure uninterrupted student placement eligibility.
Communicates agreement status updates and timing needs to internal stakeholders and external partners to support student placements.
Compliance and Clinical Placement Requirements:
Verifies student eligibility for clinical placements by confirming completion of required compliance, credentialing, and onboarding requirements.
Coordinates with internal departments and external clinical partners to ensure completion of placement requirements for away rotations and extramural clinical experiences.
Maintains documentation supporting student eligibility for clinical placements and external rotations.
Monitors compliance with institutional policies governing away rotations and extramural clinical experiences, and communicates with students regarding outstanding requirements and placement readiness
Intermediate skill in data management, spreadsheet analysis, records maintenance, and administrative process coordination and documentation.
Knowledge of clinical education structures within health professions programs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate decisions and requirements clearly to students, faculty, staff and external clinical partners.
Knowledge of academic scheduling and student records administration.
Ability to analyze scheduling constraints and apply institutional policies to scheduling decisions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a high-volume operational environment.
Ability to establish and maintain collaborative working relationships with students, faculty, staff, and external clinical partners.
Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling student academic records and placement documentation.
